user_query: I'm a sports enthusiast and a nature lover. Can you provide me with the latest IPL news to stay updated on the cricket world? Additionally, recommend some climate change news articles to deepen my understanding of environmental issues. Finally, suggest some eco-friendly activities in my city to promote sustainability.
